title: Spotify launches Listening Activity on iOS and Android, letting users view friends' real-time listening via the sidebar alongside chats, as an opt-in feature (Terrence O'Brien/The Verge)
summary: Terrence O'Brien / The Verge: Spotify launches Listening Activity on iOS and Android, letting users view friends' real-time listening via the sidebar alongside chats, as an opt-in feature — The company is also adding a Request to Jam option to mobile chats. … Since almost day one, Spotify has offered the ability …
